_readme: Every entry needs a reason and an owner-visible plan. A waiver is a debt
record, not a way to keep shipping a false claim: user-visible text must
always tell the truth, even when a legacy filename cannot be changed yet.

_filename_claims_reason.fsc_superpack_10000: Legacy filename claims 10,000; the pack holds 5,520 unique cases. All user-visible text now states 5,520. The file is referenced by Salesforce/manifest.json, src/data/salesforceClouds.ts, src/data/salesforce/financialSuperpack.ts, scripts/build_precomputed_stats.mjs and a binary zip, so the rename lands with Wave-2 Salesforce packaging when the zip is regenerated anyway.
_filename_claims_reason.financial_services_cloud_5000_variantB: Legacy filename claims 5,000; the variant holds 520 cases. Same rename window as above. Not sold in Wave 1.
